Full skill text at 5★
Deals DMG by 100% of the owner's ATK to all enemies. There is a 40% chance to inflict [Feebleness I] on the enemies for 2 turns. If the enemy has higher HP than the owner, increases the owner's Direct DMG dealt by 10%.
Full skill text at 7★
Deals DMG by 100% of the owner's ATK to all enemies. There is a 60% chance to inflict [Feebleness I] on the enemies for 2 turns. If the enemy has higher HP than the owner, increases the owner's Direct DMG dealt by 20%. Cooldown -1 Grants the owner [ATK Up I] for 2 turns before attacking.
